verifications.claim: Kohl's stores are closed on Easter Sunday (April 5, 2026).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Is Kohl's open on Easter? No, Kohl's stores will be closed on April 5.' (Easter 2026 is April 5); R2: 'Kohl's stores are closed on the following three holidays: Easter Sunday'; R3: 'Is Kohl's open on Easter? No, Kohl's will be closed on Easter.'; R4: 'Kohl's will be closing all its stores for 24 hours on Sunday... in observance of Easter'; R5: 'All Kohl’s locations will be closed on Easter Sunday... All Kohl's locations will be closed on Easter Sunday 2026.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm Kohl's closure on Easter Sunday, with R1 and R5 specifying April 5, 2026.

verifications.claim: Kohl's treats Easter as a full shutdown day.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.reasoning: R5 directly uses 'full shutdown'; R4 specifies 'all-day' and '24 hours'; R2 implies full closure.
